# Yonsei STL

> Research project pages from Seamless Trans-X Lab, Yonsei University.

This file maps published project pages for agents that request it. It does not replace the HTML pages, the sitemap, or the papers.

## Publications

- [Publication index](https://yonsei-stl.github.io/publications/): Published Yonsei STL research project pages
- [RM-MLLM: Robust Scene Understanding in Adverse Weather with RGB-Multispectral Fusion](https://yonsei-stl.github.io/RM-MLLM/): A multispectral multimodal language model and the DENSE-QA benchmark for adverse-weather driving scene understanding, using synchronized RGB and multispectral images.
- [RASMD: RGB And SWIR Multispectral Driving Dataset for Robust Perception in Adverse Conditions](https://yonsei-stl.github.io/RASMD/): A large-scale driving dataset of 100,000 aligned RGB-SWIR pairs, with benchmarks for object detection and RGB-to-SWIR translation in adverse conditions.
- [SpectraDiff: Enhancing the Fidelity of Infrared Image Translation with Object-Aware Diffusion](https://yonsei-stl.github.io/SpectraDiff/): A diffusion model that translates RGB images to infrared using semantic segmentation and a Spectral Attention Block, evaluated on FLIR, FMB, MFNet, IDD-AW, and RANUS.
- [Seeing through the rain: An empirical assessment of short-wave infrared imaging on enhancing autonomous vehicle perception under rainy weather](https://yonsei-stl.github.io/SeeingThroughRain/): A measurement-driven comparison of RGB and SWIR imaging in real rainy driving scenes using 620 paired frames, 14 image-quality metrics, visibility estimation, and fixed pretrained perception models.
- [Multi-Modal Cross-Attention-Based Multi-Label Weather and Severity Level Classification](https://yonsei-stl.github.io/MWSC/): MWSC jointly predicts multiple weather conditions and one severity level using global–local and image–text cross-attention, evaluated on 40,205 annotated driving images.
- [Pix2Next: Leveraging Vision Foundation Models for RGB to NIR Image Translation](https://yonsei-stl.github.io/Pix2Next/): An RGB-to-NIR translation model that uses a vision foundation model, cross-attention, and a multi-scale PatchGAN, with results on RANUS, IDD-AW, and zero-shot BDD100K.
- [IVIFormer: Illumination-Aware Infrared-Visible Image Fusion via Adaptive Domain-Switching Cross Attention](https://yonsei-stl.github.io/IVIFormer/): IVIFormer adapts infrared–visible image fusion to day and night by switching the query and key/value domains in cross-attention, guided by a lightweight illumination classifier.
- [Short-Wave Infrared (SWIR) Imaging for Robust Material Classification: Overcoming Limitations of Visible Spectrum Data](https://yonsei-stl.github.io/SWIR-Material-Classification/): SWIR-based material discrimination of visually similar objects: real and artificial fruits and vegetables, humans, mannequins, and banners, using moisture-sensitive spectral bands.
